SKILL-IMPORT skill build Config: …

The universal reception organ for the Therantai skill ecosystem zip. Runs a three-verdict merge protocol when a zip or skill bundle arrives from another builder — unique-to-receiver skills are left untouched, overlapping skills are overwritten by the zip (zip is canonical), and unique-to-zip skills are staged and flagged for permanent installation. Self-contained — designed to travel inside the zip so the receiver has the import protocol the moment they have the skills. Invoke with /skill-import, "import these skills", "install the zip", "I received a skill bundle", "help me install Venkatesh's skills", "how do I install this zip", or any moment a zip or folder of external SKILL.md files arrives and the question is how to bring them in without collision or silent overwrite.
